name: session-desk
description: A pane that reminds you of your open Claude Desktop sessions: where each one was left, with color marks and a done check to keep the list short.

defaultPeriod.title: Default period
defaultPeriod.description: The period the pane lists in full until you pick another in the pane: 48h, 2d-10d (48 hours to 10 days ago), week (since Monday) or 30d.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the open pane refreshes itself. 0 refreshes only on open and on the Refresh button.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the one-line summary of each session (an alias such as haiku, or a full model id).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane and of the summaries.

groupByColor.title: Group by color
groupByColor.description: List marked sessions first, grouped by color. Off, the list keeps the most recent first.
